name: gsplatform
description: GSPlatform - 3D Gaussian Splatting scene platform monorepo

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:web & pnpm run dev:viewer & pnpm run dev:xr & wait
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:viewer
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:viewer && pnpm run typecheck:xr
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:viewer
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:viewer && pnpm run build:xr
scripts.api:check: cd apps/api && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && .venv/bin/python -m mypy app && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
